status: Binary-star definition authorized26Oct2026 and integrated; remaining load/reactor/drone proposals still not implemented

approved_scope.growth: More crew and drones later; each technology needs a plausible energy profile

astronomy_assumptions.note: User authorizes defining both stars and using them in physics/UI. Display positions/radii unchanged. Energy coordinates map1800display-km to1physicalAU, preserving real local metres. Two quiet K dwarfs:5000K/0.8Rsun and4200K/0.65Rsun; luminosities derived from R²T⁴. Bolometric energy model, not UV/particle-dose acceptance.

solar.damage_rule: EffectiveArea=min(actual remaining PV area, original full area*condition); missing modules and electrical damage counted once.

reactor.thermal_note: 40kWe is a reference class under development, not proof of a certified central inhabited-station reactor. Shielding, coolant, ramp limits and radiator integration remain open.

exterior.note: 16kWh and historical sortie consumption retained as project baseline; external propulsion/tool consumption is paid through the onboard battery, not also counted as live station load.

interior.note: Illustrative conventional copper-electromagnet model only. R-01 currently has no mass/battery/magnetic solver; its free-hovering work path is not an engineered 8cm maglev guide. Fringing/return gaps/temperature may greatly increase power; permanent-magnet-assisted designs or shorter gaps may lower it.
